“mayhaṁ.l: Tuyhaṁ gaṇhāhī”ti vutte “mayhaṁ gaṇhāmī”ti vadati, sudinnaṁ suggahitañcā
“mayhaṁ.g: ettha “yathā parato ‘tava santhakaṁ karohī’ti vutte duddinnampi ‘sādhu bhante mayhaṁ gaṇhāmī’ti vacanena ‘suggahitaṁ hotī’ti vuttaṁ, evamidhāpi ‘tuyhaṁ gaṇhāhī’ti vutte sudinnattā ‘mayhaṁ gaṇhāmī’ti avuttepi ‘sudinnamevā’ti” vadanti.

“mayhaṁ.l: Sammāsambuddho “mayhaṁ kathā niyyātī”ti mukhasampattameva kathetīti cintayiṁsū

“musā.g: idaṁ pubbabhāgacetanañca sanniṭṭhānacetanañca ekato katvā vuttaṁ.

“mettā.l: yato kho te bhikkhu ajjhattaṁ cittaṁ ṭhitaṁ hoti susaṇṭhitaṁ, na ca uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā cittaṁ pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti, tato te bhikkhu evaṁ sikkhitabbaṁ “mettā me cetovimutti bhāvitā bhavissati -pa- Susamāraddhā

“mūlāni.l: kusalamūlena ekamūlā”ti hi pucchāya katāya “mūlāni yāni jakato uppajjantī”ti heṭṭhā vuttanayeneva vissajjanaṁ kātabbaṁ bhaveyyā
“mūlāni.g: vuttaṁ, tampi tathā na sakkā vattuṁ.
